name: @factstack/skills
description: Skill-bundle emitters for AI coding agents. Reads an AgentArtifact + HumanArtifact, produces format-specific files (Claude SKILL.md, Cursor .cursorrules, GitHub Copilot copilot-instructions.md) via per-format renderers fed from one canonical SkillSpec IR. Isomorphic — composes with @factstack/spec's FileWriter so the same orchestrator runs in the CLI (NodeFileWriter), the browser (FsaFileWriter), or in-memory tests (MemoryFileWriter).
